_doc: Jordan's rulings on the catalogue Sunburst plates, applied by scripts/register/bodies/push-bodies.ts. scaleFlags: when set, a plate whose height-based and width-based scales disagree by more than 5% is still approved; the plate's own px/mm is the truth and components tie to it by seat-to-foot (docs/COMPONENT_REGISTER_COMPONENTS.md). hold: a plate loads as measured (not drawn) until it is re-rendered; the reason is recorded on the row. secondPass.released: plates Jordan held on the first pass that the second pass (--pass lit) re-rendered; they load by the normal rule on DEV for review, and production promotion stays a separate step.

scaleFlags.ruling: approved from the plate gallery review (claude.ai/artifact/4ruLy5pMDufbt4DNJmpajY); the scale flag stays recorded per plate

reviewStatus.ruling: the six plates the outline gate marked review (Diamond 60, Empire 100, Round 128 x2, Vial 1 ml plug x2) stay measured until named

secondPass.ruling: run all of them through 2.5 Sunburst with the glass reference images on file (clear, frosted, cobalt, amber); Boston round amber is the amber reference; clean edges; the reducer and the plug come out of the necks and the plug becomes its own part; dip tubes are to be created
